_doc: vehicle id -> nation code of the flag on its icon (nation of origin; an export variant: the nation it was exported to). Codes: US, FR, DE, RU, UA, IT, GB, KR, SU (flags.py draws these).

f_16c.note: F-16C Block 50, USAF (War Thunder f_16c_block_50, USA tree); the model carries USAF markings (AZ tail code)

a_10.note: A-10C Thunderbolt II, USAF (War Thunder USA tree); the model carries USAF markings (EL tail code)

f_15c.note: F-15C, USAF (War Thunder USA tree); the model carries USAF markings

a_10a.note: A-10A Thunderbolt II, USAF (War Thunder a_10a_late, USA tree); European One camouflage, USAF markings

f_16a.note: F-16A, USAF; the supplied model wears the USAF Thunderbirds scheme

f_4c.note: F-4C Phantom II, USAF (War Thunder USA tree); the supplied model wears US Navy markings, also US

f_4e.note: F-4E Phantom II (ROKAF): owner decision 2026-10-23, a Republic of Korea Air Force airframe (US-built export; War Thunder f-4e stats). The model wears ROKAF style markings (round fuselage roundel, grey camouflage, red stars on the nose); South Korean flag as the exported-to nation

f_4d.note: F-4D Phantom II, USAF (no War Thunder unit; nearest the USA-tree F-4C); the supplied model wears USAF South-East Asia camouflage (FG tail code), also US

f_4b.note: F-4B Phantom II, US Navy (no War Thunder unit); the supplied model wears VF-111 Sundowners markings (USS Coral Sea, NAVY, red sunburst tail), real Navy service markings, also US

f_15ex.note: F-15EX Eagle II, USAF; the supplied model wears a South-East Asia camouflage scheme

f_22a.note: F-22A Raptor, USAF (no War Thunder unit); the model carries USAF markings (FF tail code)

f_15e.note: F-15E Strike Eagle, USAF (War Thunder USA tree); the model carries USAF markings

fa_18c.note: F/A-18C Hornet, US Marine Corps (VMFA-323 markings on the supplied model)

fa_18e.note: F/A-18E Super Hornet, US Navy (War Thunder USA tree); the model carries US Navy markings

ah1w_super_cobra.note: AH-1W SuperCobra, US Marine Corps (War Thunder USA tree ah_1w); the model wears USMC MARINES markings

sa341f_gazelle.note: SA 341F Gazelle, French Army ALAT (War Thunder France tree sa_341f); the model wears the Armee de Terre roundel and woodland camouflage

ah_56a.note: Lockheed AH-56A Cheyenne, US Army (War Thunder USA helicopter tree ah_56a); the model wears US ARMY markings

fv721_fox.note: FV721 Fox (CVR(W)), British Army (War Thunder Great Britain tree uk_fv721_fox); desert tan model

f_14c.note: F-14C Tomcat (never-built Grumman proposal, US Navy; War Thunder has no F-14C, the F-14D is USA tree); the supplied model wears US Navy markings (black scheme)

mig_25pd.note: MiG-25PD Foxbat-E interceptor, Soviet Air Defence Forces (War Thunder USSR tree mig_25pd); the supplied model wears Soviet red stars, number 16

mirage_3e.note: Mirage IIIE, French Air Force (War Thunder mirage_3e, France tree); the supplied model wears French roundels and the 13-QL code. FR was already in flags.py

mirage_4a.note: Mirage IVA strategic bomber, French Air Force (not in War Thunder); the supplied model wears French roundels and the code BB. FR was already in flags.py

vautour_iin.note: SNCASO SO-4050 Vautour IIN two-seat all-weather fighter, French Air Force (War Thunder France tree so_4050_vautour_2n and 2n_late); the supplied model wears French roundels and the code 6-QE. FR was already in flags.py

vulcan_b2.note: Avro Vulcan B.2 strategic bomber, Royal Air Force (not in War Thunder); the supplied model wears RAF roundels and the serial XM607 (the Black Buck 1 aircraft). GB was already in flags.py

h_6k.note: Xi'an H-6K bomber, People's Liberation Army Air Force (not in War Thunder); the supplied model wears the PLAAF red star and the number 20038. CN was already in flags.py

su_15tm.note: Su-15TM Flagon-F interceptor, Soviet Air Defence Forces (War Thunder USSR tree su_15tm, not yet in the datamine); the supplied model wears Soviet red stars, number 43

yak_38m.note: Yak-38M Forger-A VTOL strike fighter, Soviet Naval Aviation (War Thunder USSR tree yak-38m); the supplied model wears Soviet red stars, number 27

f_102a.note: F-102A Delta Dagger, USAF Air Defense Command (War Thunder f_102a_late, USA tree); the supplied model wears US AIR FORCE markings, serial 61188

fc_31.note: FC-31 Gyrfalcon prototype 31001 (2012), Shenyang / AVIC (not in War Thunder); the supplied model wears the marking 31001. CN flag added to flags.py

mi_24p.note: Mi-24P Hind-F, Soviet Air Force (War Thunder USSR tree mi_24p); the supplied model wears Soviet red stars and the number 29

mi_8amtsh.note: Mi-8AMTSh Terminator, Russian Aerospace Forces (War Thunder USSR tree mi_8amtsh, rank VI); the supplied model wears the Russian red-star roundel, the number 69 and the legend VVS ROSSII, so the Russian flag

yak_141.note: Yak-141 Freestyle (Yak-41M) VTOL fighter prototype, Yakovlev OKB for Soviet Naval Aviation (War Thunder USSR tree yak_141); the supplied model wears Soviet red stars on the fins and the call sign 77, so the Soviet flag

m1a1_tusk.note: M1A1 Abrams with the Tank Urban Survival Kit (TUSK), US Army (War Thunder USA tree us_m1a1_hc_abrams for the data); the supplied model wears US flags on the hull and turret

puma_ifv.note: Schuetzenpanzer Puma, Bundeswehr (War Thunder Germany tree germ_schutzenpanzer_puma); the supplied model wears the Balkenkreuz and the German flag

strela_10m2.note: 9K35 Strela-10M2 (NATO SA-13 Gopher) on the MT-LB, Soviet Union (War Thunder USSR tree ussr_9a35_m2); the supplied model is plain green with no national markings

pgz_95.note: PGZ-95 (Type 95) self-propelled anti-aircraft gun, People's Liberation Army (not in War Thunder; its PGZ04A is the nearest unit); the supplied model wears the PLA red star

t64bv.note: T-64BV obr. 1985 in Ukrainian service (the owner resolved the nation question for the supplied T-64BV model as Ukraine: the model carries the 2UA badges; War Thunder ussr_t_64_b_1984 for the data)

m113a3.note: M113A3 (RISE) in US Army service, the nation of origin (War Thunder USA / Italy tree it_m113a1_tow for the armament; the supplied model wears a woodland camouflage and no national marking, the flag is the nation of origin)

zbd_05.note: ZBD-05 amphibious IFV, PLA Ground Force (the supplied model wears the PLA marine digital camouflage; War Thunder has no ZBD-05, the nearest unit cn_zbd_04a gives the data)

tos_1a.note: TOS-1A Solntsepyok (24-tube BM-1 on the T-72A chassis), Russian Ground Forces since 2003; the supplied model carries a Russian flag on the hull side. No War Thunder unit
